crainic.key: Bubu. Round, cheerful, starts with a bang. First bomb of every round is huge (+2 range).
crainic.text: Bubu. Round, cheerful, starts with a bang. First bomb of every round is huge (+2 range).

crainic.key: Gugu. Heavy, stubborn, hard to get rid of. Two lives: survives the first hit.
crainic.text: Gugu. Heavy, stubborn, hard to get rid of. Two lives: survives the first hit.

crainic.key: Zuzu. Blink and you missed her. Fastest character in the game.
crainic.text: Zuzu. Blink and you missed her. Fastest character in the game.

crainic.key: Striker. Every bomb is a ball. Permanent Kick; kicked bombs bounce back once.
crainic.text: Striker. Every bomb is a ball. Permanent Kick; kicked bombs bounce back once.

crainic.key: Fifi. Graceful, and grabs everything. Magnet: picks up good power-ups from neighbouring tiles.
crainic.text: Fifi. Graceful, and grabs everything. Magnet: picks up good power-ups from neighbouring tiles.

crainic.key: Auntie Veta. Handbag, headscarf, zero patience. Permanent Glove and an 8-second shield at the start.
crainic.text: Auntie Veta. Handbag, headscarf, zero patience. Permanent Glove and an 8-second shield at the start.

crainic.key: Chef. Cooks with fire. Literally. His blasts leave oil for 2s that slows everyone else.
crainic.text: Chef. Cooks with fire. Literally. His blasts leave oil for 2s that slows everyone else.

crainic.key: Master Fitil. Knows every fuse by heart. Sees the countdown of every bomb.
crainic.text: Master Fitil. Knows every fuse by heart. Sees the countdown of every bomb.

crainic.key: Robo-Mici. Beep. Boop. Boom. Immune to slow, reverse, dizzy and hiccups; permanent Kick.
crainic.text: Robo-Mici. Beep. Boop. Boom. Immune to slow, reverse, dizzy and hiccups; permanent Kick.

crainic.key: Ghost. Crates? What crates? Walks through one crate every 20 seconds.
crainic.text: Ghost. Crates? What crates? Walks through one crate every 20 seconds.

crainic.key: Magician. Now you see the bomb… now it’s a pigeon. Once per round, an enemy bomb that would hit him turns into a pigeon.

crainic.key: Nova. Why aim down a line when you can hit the whole block? Her bombs blast a whole area around them (radius = bomb range, up to 3), not a cross. Her own blasts never hurt her.
crainic.text: Nova. Why aim down a line when you can hit the whole block? Her bombs blast a whole area around them (radius = bomb range, up to 3), not a cross. Her own blasts never hurt her.

crainic.key: Shade. Now you see him… now it’s just smoke. The fastest hero, but carries few bombs.
crainic.text: Shade. Now you see him... now it's just smoke. The fastest hero, but carries few bombs.

crainic.key: Portia. Why walk around when you can step through? Starts with the boot: kicks bombs from the first second.

crainic.key: Slick. Fast hands, faster feet, and a lot of ice. Flick the joystick (Shift + arrow on keyboard) to slide 3 tiles. No steering mid-slide.
